WITH cust_annual AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, c.Currency,
         SUM(COALESCE(y.Consumption,0)) AS annual_consumption
  FROM customers c
  LEFT JOIN yearmonth y
    ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
   AND y.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
  WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment, c.Currency
), minval AS (
  SELECT MIN(annual_consumption) AS min_consumption FROM cust_annual
)
SELECT ca.CustomerID, ca.Segment, ca.Currency, ca.annual_consumption AS Consumption
FROM cust_annual ca
JOIN minval m ON ca.annual_consumption = m.min_consumption;

answer_sql:
WITH cust_annual AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, c.Currency,
         SUM(COALESCE(y.Consumption,0)) AS annual_consumption
  FROM customers c
  LEFT JOIN yearmonth y
    ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
   AND y.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
  WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment, c.Currency
), minval AS (
  SELECT MIN(annual_consumption) AS min_consumption FROM cust_annual
)
SELECT ca.CustomerID, ca.Segment, ca.Currency, ca.annual_consumption AS Consumption
FROM cust_annual ca
JOIN minval m ON ca.annual_consumption = m.min_consumption;
